# HowToPronounce.com

> > Crowdsourced multilingual pronunciation dictionary with audio samples from native speakers for words, names, and phrases across languages.

HowToPronounce.com is a community-driven pronunciation learning platform featuring phonetic transcriptions, audio recordings, and translations. The site specializes in helping users learn correct pronunciation of celebrity names, place names, baby names, and common words through crowdsourced audio contributions and IPA notation.

## Core Pronunciation Resources

- [How To Pronounce: Online Multilingual Pronunciation Dictionary](https://www.howtopronounce.com/): Homepage: crowdsourced multilingual pronunciation dictionary
- [Learn how to pronounce names](https://www.howtopronounce.com/names/index.php): Name pronunciation guide with audio from native speakers
- [English Pronunciation Dictionary](https://www.howtopronounce.com/english/index.php): English pronunciation dictionary with crowdsourced audio

## Language-Specific Dictionaries

- [Πώς Να Προφέρει: Σε Απευθείας Σύνδεσης Πολύγλωσσο Προφορά Λεξικό](https://el.howtopronounce.com/): Greek language version of multilingual pronunciation dictionary

## Pronunciation Examples

- [How to pronounce words](https://www.howtopronounce.com/words): Word pronunciation with IPA transcription and audio samples
- [How to pronounce pronunciation](https://www.howtopronounce.com/pronunciation): Pronunciation entry with 104 audio samples and translations
